researchResults.title: Valor, Point72 back General Intuition at $6B valuation as AI startup pushes into robotics
researchResults.description: General Intuition, the startup building a foundation model that trains generalized AI agents how to move through space and time, is in talks to raise at a $6 billion pre-money valuation from new investors including Valor Ventures, Point72 Ventures, and Seven Seven Six.

researchResults.title: Situational Awareness, star AI hedge fund that nearly imploded, now being probed by the SEC
researchResults.description: The AI hedge fund went from "the talk of Wall Street" to "subject of federal subpoenas" faster than you can say "diversify your portfolio."

researchResults.title: Instinct’s powerful AI assistant is raising privacy and security concerns
researchResults.description: Early testers are raving about what Instinct can do, but some say the AI assistant’s sweeping access, broad terms and ability to act on users’ behalf come with uncomfortable trade-offs.

researchResults.title: Trump bought SpaceX shares two weeks after blockbuster IPO
researchResults.description: The president bought when the stock was in the mid-$150 range. SpaceX finished trading on Monday back at its IPO price of $135.
